title: 定时任务 native Schedule 全链闭环

root_cause.shell: The Schedules route, projection parsing and prompt handoff were coupled to Home. The route had no native InputTrigger source of its own and did not visibly state the safe replacement ordering required for edits.
root_cause.schedule_projection: The existing read-only /emate.schedules projection already folded native Schedule events and required no second scheduler or write endpoint; its missing closure was focused restart, after-rule and cancellation coverage.
root_cause.tool_visibility: T05 was already present at the integration baseline and kept schedule_create, schedule_list and schedule_delete Agent-local in both Tool Search registration orders. T06 consumes that contract without reimplementing it.

resolution.extraction: SchedulesPage now owns the previous route state, projection parsing, filtering, status and prompt UI. Home remains a thin route delegate; its non-Schedules behavior is unchanged.
resolution.native_handoff: Create, edit and delete continue through the existing Workspace, Session and Composer path. No Workspace invokes the native directory picker and Workspace create/connect seam; cancellation stops before creation or navigation.
resolution.mutation_policy: The management page remains read-only. Create requires confirmation before schedule_create; delete requires schedule_list verification and confirmation before schedule_delete; edit explicitly creates the replacement successfully before deleting the old Schedule.
resolution.input_trigger: The Shell registers one native @定时任务 InputTrigger reference. It inserts Composer text only; Tool execution remains Agent-local and T05-owned visibility remains intact.
